cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my spare key or return it. I taught you to say exactly what you meant; let's find out what last week's 'take some space' meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole answer, at last. Keep the key, then, and I'll take that evening as finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take that evening as the first night you were leaving. Don't soften the word, like you used to in our practice talks. Pocket the key, or put it here and tell me we're parting.

reason: Make mentor correction drive the exact interpersonal tactic and make the final line something A needs B to do or hear. Preserve legitimate B questions and material evidence rather than writing a lesson-summary ending.
